title: Indlu kaKhondlo
description: UKhondlo ufuna indlu etja. Iinlwana ezinomusa zinikela ngokwabelana naye amakhaya wazo. Kodwana akukho akubona kulungile ngaphandle kobana azitholele isikhundlana sakhe esincani, esifuthumelako nesiledlhileko.
